name: Kemono Onsen
source:
Kemono Onsen is about is the main character(you) is down on his luck after recently losing his job and struggling to keep a roof over his head, you receive a mysterious letter that may solve all your problems or bring you more than you can handle. Can you handle what the future holds?

[From [url=https://jking1200.itch.io/steamy-hot-springs]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Kemono Onsen》的主角就是你。最近失去工作的你正走霉运，连维持住处都十分艰难。这时，一封神秘来信出现了。它或许能解决你所有的问题，也可能带来远超你承受能力的麻烦。你能应对未来的一切吗？

[摘自[url=https://jking1200.itch.io/steamy-hot-springs]itch.io[/url]]
